svg.aria-label: Photoshoot. Web app and Windows 1.5.1. Strike a pose, pick from 52 live effects and reactive face masks, keep the strip. Nothing from your camera leaves your device. Built with TypeScript, Electron, WebGL2 and MediaPipe. The screenshot shows the Photoshoot product site for version 1.5.1.
